topic: Joining the Neighborhood Walking and Running Club

script.title: THE WALKING CLUB
script.scene_zh: 公園步道 · 加入社團
script.story_hook: New to town, and the club meets at dawn.
script.intro_zh: 剛搬到這裡，而社團一大早就出發。
script.welcome_en: Hey, today we're at a Saturday morning park walk. Listen for joining-a-club phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嘿，今天我們來到週六清晨的公園。留意加入社團的說法。
script.outro: And the easy group is on the move. Listen again and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 輕鬆組出發了。再聽一次，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her twenties with a long blonde ponytail, a light teal running jacket over a grey tank, black leggings, and a slim athletic build
script.char_b_description: a tall older man in his early sixties with curly light-grey hair, a thick grey beard, a green track jacket over a white tee, running shorts, and a lean build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the Saturday walking club?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈsætədeɪ ˈwɔkɪŋ klʌb/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問這是週六的散步社團嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sure is! Are you joining us today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊr ɪz ɑɹ ju dʒɔɪnɪŋ ʌs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！你今天要跟我們一起走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, first time, kind of, well, sort of.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm fɝst taɪm kaɪnd əv wɛl sɔɹt əv/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，第一次，算是第一次吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, I'm Ted, I host the morning walks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm aɪm tɛd aɪ hoʊst ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ wɔks/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，我是 Ted，早上的散步由我帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you. I'm nervous, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mi tʃu aɪm ˈnɝvəs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你。說實話我有點緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't be, half these folks are new too.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt bi hæf ðiz foʊks ɑɹ nju tu/
dialogue.zh: 別緊張，這裡一半的人也是新來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? They look like they run marathons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðeɪ lʊk laɪk ðeɪ ɹʌn ˈmæɹəθɑnz/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？他們看起來都像跑馬拉松的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's just Greg, he's been coming years.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts dʒʌst ɡɹɛɡ hiz bɪn ˈkʌmɪŋ jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那只是 Greg，他來好幾年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what time do you usually start?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt taɪm du ju ˈjuʒuəli stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那你們通常幾點開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharp at seven, we roll out by seven-ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑɹp ət ˈsɛvən wi ɹoʊl aʊt baɪ ˈsɛvən tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 七點整，最晚七點十分出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven on a Saturday... okay, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ɑn ə ˈsætədeɪ oʊˈkeɪ aɪ kən du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 週六七點⋯⋯好，我可以做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Just showing up is the whole trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd dʒʌst ˈʃoʊɪn ʌp ɪz ðə hoʊl tɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 很好，每週都來就是訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far do you walk each week?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑɹ du ju wɔk itʃ wik/
dialogue.zh: 你們每週大概走多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three miles, but we never push it.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θɹi maɪlz bʌt wi ˈnɛvɚ pʊʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大約三英里，但我們從不勉強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three miles. Um, is there a slower group?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi maɪlz ʌm ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈsloʊɚ ɡɹup/
dialogue.zh: 三英里。嗯，有比較慢的組別嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always. We've got an easy pace and a fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz wiv ɡɑt ən ˈizil peɪs ænd ə fæst/
dialogue.zh: 一定有。我們有輕鬆組，也有快組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief. I'll take the easy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɹɪˈlif aɪl teɪk ði ˈizil wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那就放心了，我走輕鬆組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you'll love it, no one gets dropped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt jul lʌv ɪt noʊ wʌn ɡɛts ɹɑpt/
dialogue.zh: 完美，你會喜歡的，不會把任何人丟下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Do I need any special shoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt du aɪ nid ˈɛni ˈspɛʃəl ʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 好。我需要特別的鞋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just comfy sneakers, no need to buy more.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈkʌmfi ˈsnikɚz noʊ nid tə baɪ mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 只要舒服的球鞋，不用再買新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, mine are old but they still work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪn ɑɹ oʊld bʌt ðeɪ stɪl wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我的鞋很舊但還能穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's all you need, we're not racing here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɔl ju nid wɪɹ nɑɹ ˈɹesɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那就夠了，我們這裡不比賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, should I bring water or anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ ˈwɔɾɚ ɔɹ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那我要帶水之類的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your own bottle, we don't have spares.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ jɔɹ on ˈbɑɾəl wi doʊnt hæv spɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 自備水壺，我們沒有多餘的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll grab some before we head out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt aɪl ɡɹæb sʌm bɪˈfɔɹ wi hɛd aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 知道了，出發前我先去買點水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a fountain near the parking lot, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə ˈfaʊnɾən nɪɹ ðə ˈpɑɹkɪŋ lɑt tu/
dialogue.zh: 停車場附近也有飲水台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I didn't see that when I came in.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs aɪ ˈdɪdənt si ðæt wɛn aɪ keɪm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好，我進來的時候沒看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's easy to miss, tucked behind the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈizil tə mɪs tʌk bɪˈhaɪnd ðə saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 很容易錯過，藏在牌子後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I get tired on the route?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ ɡɛt ˈtaɪɚd ɑn ðə ɹut/
dialogue.zh: 如果我在路上累了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can take the shortcut back any time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən teɪk ðə ˈʃɔɹtcʌt bæk ˈɛni taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 你隨時可以走捷徑先回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shortcut? Is there a shorter loop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈʃɔɹtcʌt ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈʃɔɹtɚ lup/
dialogue.zh: 捷徑？有比較短的路線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, the green trail cuts the walk in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ðə ɡɹin tɹeɪl kʌts ðə wɔk ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 有，走綠線可以把路程減半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's smart, I like having options.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts smɑɹt aɪ laɪk ˈhævɪŋ ˈɑpʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 真聰明，我喜歡有選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people use it their first two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl juz ɪt ðɛɹ fɝst tu wɪks/
dialogue.zh: 大多數人前兩週都會用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I was worried about keeping up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪ wəz ˈwɝid əˈbaʊt ˈkipɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 知道就好，我正擔心會跟不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody worries here, we walk at the slowest pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbɑdi ˈwɝiz hɪɹ wi wɔk ət ðə ˈsloʊɪst peɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒人會擔心，我們按最慢的步調走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You walk at the slowest person's pace?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɔk ət ðə ˈsloʊɪst ˈpɝsənz peɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你們按照最慢那個人的速度來走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always. That's the only rule that really counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz ðæts ði ˈoʊnli ɹul ðæt ˈɹiəli kaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 一定。這是唯一真正重要的規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that a lot, it feels friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt ə lɑt ɪt filz ˈfɹɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 我非常喜歡，感覺很親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. Do you want to walk with me today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz du ju wɑnt tə wɔk wɪð mi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。你今天想跟我一起走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please, I'd feel better near someone.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz aɪd fil ˈbɛɾɚ nɪɹ ˈsʌmˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好啊拜託，身邊有人我會安心些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Where are you headed after this?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm wɛɹ ɑɹ ju ˈhɛdɪd ˈæftɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。走完之後你要去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just brunch, um, there's a café down the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst bɹʌntʃ ʌm ðɛɹz ə kəˈfeɪ daʊn ðə ɹod/
dialogue.zh: 就去吃早午餐，嗯，路邊有一家咖啡館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, we all go there after, it's our spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wi ɔl ɡoʊ ðɛɹ ˈæftɚ ɪts ɑʊɹ spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我們走完都去那裡，那是我們的老地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's nice, I was going to eat alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæts naɪs aɪ wəz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə it əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？真好，我本來打算一個人吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You won't today, we saved you an open seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju woʊnt təˈdeɪ wi seɪvd ju ən ˈoʊpən sit/
dialogue.zh: 今天不會了，我們幫你留了空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, well, if you're offering, I'll join.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ wɛl ɪf jʊɹ ˈɔfɚɪŋ aɪl dʒɔɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，既然你都這麼說，那我就一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Consider it a done deal. Ready to start?
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈsɪdɚ ɪt ə dʌn dil ˈɹɛdi tə stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣說定了。準備開始了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one more thing, can I bring my sister?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈsɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，還有件事，我能帶我妹妹來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her along, the more the merrier.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ hɚ əˈlɔŋ ðə mɔɹ ðə ˈmɛɹiɚ/
dialogue.zh: 帶她一起來，人越多越熱鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's shy, but she needs to get moving more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ʃaɪ bʌt ʃi nidz tə ɡɛt ˈmuːvɪŋ mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 她很害羞，但她真的需要多動一動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the best place, zero pressure at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ðə bɛst pleɪs ˈzɪɹoʊ ˈpɹɛʃɚ ət ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 這裡最適合，完全沒有任何壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I feel way better about this already.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ fil weɪ ˈbɛɾɚ əˈbaʊt ðɪs ɔlˈɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在對這件事感覺好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the goal. Here we go, fall in line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ɡoʊl hɪɹ wi ɡoʊ fɔl ɪn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這就是目的。走吧，排進隊伍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lead the way. And hey, thanks for being kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /lid ðə weɪ ænd heɪ θæŋks fɚ ˈbiɪŋ kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 帶頭走吧。還有，謝謝你的親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. See you at the café after the walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm si ju ət ðə kəˈfeɪ ˈæftɚ ðə wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。散完步在咖啡館見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll catch up, don't wait if I'm slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kætʃ ʌp doʊnt weɪt ɪf aɪm sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會趕上來，如果我慢了就別等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll wait, that's the whole point of this club.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil weɪt ðæts ðə hoʊl pɔɪnt ʌv ðɪs klʌb/
dialogue.zh: 我們會等你的，這就是社團的意義。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll see you all in about three miles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl si ju ɔl ɪn əˈbaʊt θɹi maɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 那我們大約三英里之後見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You got it, see you at the finish line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɑɾ ɪt si ju ət ðə ˈfɪnɪʃ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，終點線見。

script.youtube_title: 【週六散步社團🥾】「誰都不會掉隊」第一次加入跑步社團全程聽力🎧｜聽完就會用社團英語💬｜60句沉浸式｜Join A Walking Club
script.youtube_title_en: "No One Gets Dropped" — Joining a Neighborhood Walking Club for the First Time
script.youtube_description:
「誰都不會掉隊」——剛搬到新城市，週六一大早走進公園步道，想加入散步社團卻很緊張。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在清晨的公園步道口。

你會聽到：怎麼問開始時間、輕鬆組與快組的差別、自備水壺與穿什麼鞋、走不動時的捷徑、還有社團結束後相約早午餐的閒聊。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與美國人日常短句，um、well、so、haha 這些自然語感詞通通都在。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就會記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en: "No one gets dropped" — you just moved to a new town and it's your first Saturday at the neighborhood walking club. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a dawn park trailhead. You will hear asking the start time, easy pace versus fast group, bringing your own bottle and sneakers, the shortcut when you're tired, and the after-walk brunch invite. Everything stays in A2-level words with real American small talk: um, well, so, haha. Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud. No memorizing needed, just listen often and it sticks. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧散步社團英文｜輕鬆組與快組・自備水壺・走不動有捷徑｜第一次加入社團怎麼開口｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛搬到新城市，週六一早走進公園，想加入散步社團卻擔心跟不上。有沒有比較慢的組別？累了可以中途離開嗎？

這一集帶大家來到清晨的公園步道口，從打招呼、問時間、分組、自備水壺、認得捷徑，一路聊到結束後相約早午餐，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🕖 問時間：So, what time do you usually start?
🐢 分組：Um, is there a slower group?
💧 自備水：Bring your own bottle, we don't have spares.
🔀 捷徑：You can take the shortcut back any time.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這個週六的早晨走一趟，下次自己走進社團，話就會自然冒出來。

祝你也找到一群一起走路的朋友。
script.thumbnail_action: stretching at a park sign with a running club gathering
